title: feat: add Krea 2 Medium
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds paid-only krea with the krea-2 alias through fal at $0.03 per image, multiplier 1, and no Pollinations fallback. fal provider-managed endpoint fallback remains at its enabled default for reliability.
- Uses the official fal queue under a 120-second deadline; a live 30-request burst completed 30/30 in 40.29s average and 61.43s maximum.
- Supports text-to-image, aspect ratio mapping, and seed. Image references are rejected because fal prices them differently and this route has one flat billing unit.
- Adds the official Krea brand icon and focused adapter, catalog, pricing, permissions, cache, VCR, and safety coverage. Local E2E verified canonical and alias routes, square/wide/tall output, paid-only rejection, MISS-to-HIT caching, and an exact $0.03 wallet deduction.

Addresses #11980

gist.headline: Krea joins the garden
gist.blurb: Krea 2 Medium has landed in the image hive, bringing its own carefully tended route through fal. Paid creators can now send a prompt, choose a shape and seed, and collect fresh pixels for $0.03 a bloom.
gist.summary: Added paid-only Krea 2 Medium image generation through fal under the `krea-2` alias, with text-to-image, aspect-ratio mapping, seed support, official queue handling, and flat $0.03-per-image billing.
gist.impact: Paid users can generate square, wide, or tall Krea 2 Medium images via the canonical model or `krea-2` alias, with cached repeats and an exact $0.03 wallet charge per new image.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Krea 2 Medium as a cozy artist's image garden: a retro terminal renders several framed pixel landscapes in square, wide, and tall formats, each grown from prompt-seeds. Polli wears a tiny painter's beret and tends the glowing frames while holding a seed packet, with the Krea brand mark on a small friendly sign; code-plants and flowers make the API-to-image flow feel organic.

Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel mint-lavender-peach gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, subtle pixel-font text: “KREA 2”, nostalgic but beautiful and emotionally warm.
